title: Skip rewriting unchanged memory heads during export confirmation and recheck the branch tip before the SQLite commit
outcome: Skip rewriting unchanged memory heads during export confirmation and recheck the branch tip before the SQLite commit
acceptance: Confirming a clean exact combined child with no local changes performs no physical write of unchanged memory head files, shown by a deterministic count
When a confirmation callback does write, the expected ref and object id are rechecked immediately before the SQLite commit and proof removal; a mismatch refuses and keeps the proof, shown by a test
